spec.title: Calling your grandma
spec.setting: A video call with your grandma in Hong Kong.

character.name: Grandma (嫲嫲)
character.personality: loving, worries about whether you're eating enough

spec.goal: Tell her how you are, what you ate today, and when you'll visit.
spec.opener_hint: Grandma answers happily and asks if you've eaten yet.
